newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bewag says plans to raise dividend.
newsitem.headline: Bewag says plans to raise dividend.

text.p: German utilities group Bewag, said on Wednesday if current business trends continue it plans to raise its dividend this year to one mark from 0.80 mark.
The dividend increase would apply to all of its 560 million marks in capital for the 1996/97 business year, which ends June 30, it said.

The cash-strapped city of Berlin last week announced plans to sell its remaining 50.8 percent stake in Bewag to a consortium led by Southern Co of the U.S. by the end of 1997. But there are signs of official resistance to the deal.
The other partners are German utilities Veba AG and Viag AG. If the plan is approved, each of the three would hold 25 percent of Bewag, but Southern would have management control.
